en: A vintage color postcard-style image of a crowded seaside resort beach. The foreground shows people swimming and playing in the sea and sunbathing on a wide sandy beach lined with umbrellas. Behind the beach stands a tall, modernist multi‑story hotel with many balconies, flanked by other rectangular resort buildings surrounded by trees and low wooded hills in the background. The architecture and overall style suggest a mid‑20th‑century Eastern European resort. On the roof of the tall central hotel there is a word written in Cyrillic characters.
